applicability_domain.threshold_method: 5th percentile of leave-one-out maximum Tanimoto similarities in the RF training set
applicability_domain.interpretation: The compound is below the training-derived similarity threshold. Its model prediction should be treated cautiously.

scientific_caution: This is an in-silico prediction, not experimental confirmation. Model disagreement is descriptive and is not a calibrated probability of prediction accuracy. Docking, binding affinity, functional inhibition and therapeutic efficacy are distinct evidence types.
